display.purpose: Hero headline only, one per page.

title.purpose: Page and section titles below the hero.

lede.purpose: The opening paragraph under a headline, sized up from body.

label.purpose: Channel labels, citation headings, eyebrows — uppercase mono.

numeric.purpose: Denominations and dimensions; tabular-nums so figures align in a column.

shadows.name: plate
shadows.purpose: Heaviest lift, reserved for the single most prominent element on a view (the hero anatomy stack).

motion.name: ray-travel
motion.purpose: Light-ray sweep inside mechanism diagrams that opt in via the .mech .rays path class.

motion.name: thread-draw
motion.purpose: Security-thread stroke reveal in mechanism diagrams.

motion.name: lift-in
motion.purpose: Quiet arrival fade/lift for sections and cards entering view.

motion.name: reduced-motion-override
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce sets all animation/transition durations to 0.01ms and scroll-behavior to auto
motion.purpose: Full motion opt-out; also required so no feature ever simulates the diraba touch check via animation.

narrative.overview: The material world is a printer's proof sheet pulled fresh from an intaglio press: heavy off-white stock, dense black line-work, registration marks sitting in the margin, a loupe resting nearby waiting to be picked up. This is not a metaphor borrowed for flavour — banknote design is engraving, and the site's entire visual language commits to that fact rather than decorating around it. Depth comes from ink and paper, never from glass and glow. Colour is never chosen for mood; it is chosen because it names one of Bank Indonesia's own checking methods, plus one colour — spesimen red — reserved entirely for the Pasal 24 legal marking. The one deliberate departure from the proof-sheet ground is the inspection surface: a near-black panel used only where the subject under discussion is light itself.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white proof stock as the constant ground; near-black ink as the constant figure.
Four checking-method colours used as taxonomy, never decoration; spesimen red used for nothing but the legal mark.
Flat by default — shadows read as ink pooling under stock, appearing only on hover/focus.
Sharp corners everywhere except circular pills and two small fixed-radius brand/focus marks.
Serif display face for headline weight; grotesque for reading; monospace for anything struck like note lettering.
One orchestrated motion moment (the colour-shift tilt demo); everything else is a quiet arrival fade, fully stripped under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Taxonomy Rule
rules.body: Dilihat teal, diraba copper, diterawang amber, and mesin violet mean one thing each — a checking method — everywhere on the site. Never repurpose one of these four hues for an unrelated UI state.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Spesimen red is reserved entirely for the Pasal 24 marking baked into schematic artwork. Never a button colour, an error colour, or a UI accent.

rules.name: The Ink Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is a tint of engraving ink (rgba(26,31,38,…)), never black-on-white glass elevation and never a colour-tinted glow.

rules.name: The Struck-Lettering Rule
rules.body: Space Mono is for things that were struck, not written: numbers, codes, citations, labels. Conversational prose is never mono, regardless of length.

rules.name: The Sharp-or-Pill Rule
rules.body: Every shape resolves to one of exactly two corner treatments: 0px (paper) or rounded-full (a token/chip/toggle). An 8–16px 'soft card' radius breaks the system.

dos: Do treat the four channel colours as a fixed vocabulary — reuse them only to mean dilihat/diraba/diterawang/mesin.
Do keep every shadow an ink tint at the documented Sheet/Lift/Plate stops.
Do resolve every new shape to 0px or rounded-full — nothing in between.
Do reserve Space Mono for struck lettering, and Brygada 1918 for headline-scale display only.
Do author the SPESIMEN mark into a schematic's own path geometry when adding new note-like artwork — never as a CSS layer or overlay.
donts: Don't introduce spesimen red anywhere except the baked legal mark.
Don't add a glass/frosted/glow treatment anywhere outside the header's translucent backdrop-blur.
Don't add a mid-size border-radius (8–16px) to any card, panel, or image frame.
Don't use the inspection surface as a general dark theme — it belongs only to panels where the subject is literally light.
Don't animate anything beyond the one orchestrated colour-shift tilt moment and quiet arrival fades; never simulate the diraba touch check via animation.
